meta.title: Request resume
meta.description: Watches each model route instead of each turn: when turns fail on a provider and model with a timeout, rate limit, server, or transport error, the plugin sends one small probe to that route until it answers, then presses Continue on every conversation stuck on it — including conversations left failed by an earlier run. Cancelling or using a conversation yourself takes it off the list, and probe budgets stop a route that stays down from being retried forever.
